title: Hard Projecting
texts: Hard projecting on short boulder problems

Using either a spray wall or training board (such as a Kilter, Moon, or Tension board), find or create a problem between 3-5 moves that are very hard for you but should be close to achievable after 20 minutes of work.  Because the problems are short, you should be failing because the individual moves are hard.  A good target difficulty is to use your session grade.  Spend 20 minutes working on the individual moves and links, taking as much time as you need between attempts.  

Rest for 3 minutes before moving on to another boulder.  You will complete this process on 4 boulders in total, which should take a total of 60-90 minutes to complete.  Try to choose different hold types and movement styles with each problem.

You should expect to complete at least 3 of the 4 boulders in this session, so if you fail on either of the first 2 boulders, drop the intensity.
